$comment: Bangladesh - Wave 1 launch market. This pack is the documented exemplar;
the others are terser. Validated against packs/_schema.json in CI.
PRD 1.2: 'If a new country requires a code change, the architecture has
failed.' Everything region-specific lives here - cutoffs, calibration,
units, language, meal slots, safety thresholds, food source, feature flags.

units_default.$note: numerals may be 'bengali' per user preference. Canonical SI is always what gets stored; this is display only.

anthropometric_cutoffs.$comment: Asian-Pacific, NOT Western. Playbook B9 calls this the single highest-leverage change for real-world accuracy in this population.

food.composition_source: Food Composition Table for Bangladesh (2013), INFS, University of Dhaka
food.$portion_note: Gram equivalents are per-food, not global - a বাটি of ভাত is not a বাটি of ডাল. Nulls are honest placeholders.

ramadan.$safety: Fasting with diabetes carries real risk. Entering Ramadan mode must surface a safety card advising the user to consult their doctor, and must not present a calorie deficit target during the fast.

features.$note: All false for the Stage 4 vertical slice. Flags exist now so enabling them later is config, not a release branch.

regulatory.regime: No mature SaMD regime for wellness apps
regulatory.notes: Lowest regulatory friction of any market. Store guidelines are the real gatekeeper.
